verdicts.reason: A: the dark background covers only a narrow centre strip, so most of the banner is blank white. The headline is cut to 'OPEN NIGHT IN' and the 'FREE ENTRY FO…' line collides with the observatory dome. The date, location and satellite are gone, and no text is readable at this size. B is worse: the headline is clipped to 'T IN / ORY' fragments that run off the dark patch, a stray 'F' floats near the dome, and the rest of the canvas is blank white. Both are unusable; A at least keeps a recognisable piece of the headline.
